question: Ramnad V. Raghavan was associated with which of the following musical instruments?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Mridangam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ramnad V. Raghavan** was a renowned artist associated with the **Mridangam**, a percussion instrument widely used in Carnatic music.
 
• The **Mridangam** is a double-sided drum made primarily of wood and leather.
 
• This instrument is considered the primary rhythmic accompaniment in **Carnatic music concerts.**
 
• Ramnad V. Raghavan played a significant role in promoting and teaching **Mridangam** both in India and abroad.
 
• He was known for his mastery of rhythm, technique, and his ability to blend traditional and modern styles.
 
• He taught at institutions such as the **Wesleyan University** in the United States, contributing to the global appreciation of Indian classical music.
 
• The **Mridangam** is often played during performances featuring vocalists, violinists, and other Carnatic instrumentalists.
 
• Ramnad V. Raghavan was also known for collaborating with several legendary Carnatic musicians, earning widespread acclaim.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Nadaswaram**__

 __
 
• The **Nadaswaram** is a classical wind instrument widely used in South Indian music, particularly in temple rituals and weddings.
 
• It is considered one of the loudest non-brass acoustic instruments in the world.
 
• The Nadaswaram is made of wood and is associated with auspicious occasions.
 
 
 
• **Dholak**__
 __
 
• The **Dholak** is a double-headed drum commonly used in folk music and Bollywood songs.
 
• It is smaller and more portable compared to the Mridangam.
 
• The Dholak is widely used in North Indian music traditions and in devotional gatherings.
 
 
 
• **Sarangi**__
 
 
• The **Sarangi** is a bowed string instrument used in Hindustani classical music.
 
• It is known for its ability to mimic the human voice and is often used as an accompaniment to vocal performances.
 
• The Sarangi is made primarily of wood and has gut strings.
